title: Add Audio to Video – Put Music on a Video, Free
description: Add an MP3, WAV or other sound to a video in your browser. Repeat it if it is shorter, cut where the video ends. No upload and no watermark.
heading: Add Audio to a Video
subtitle: Choose a video and a sound file, and save the video with that sound in place of its own.
intro: Put music under a slideshow, a voice-over on a screen recording, or a new soundtrack on a clip with noisy sound. Choose the video and the sound file together or one after the other; the page tells which is which. A short sound can repeat until the video ends, and a long one stops where the video stops.

features.title: Private
features.text: The video and the sound are joined by your own browser; neither is uploaded.

features.title: Fits the video
features.text: A short sound repeats if you want, and a long one is cut where the video ends.

features.title: Picture copied when it can be
features.text: H.264, HEVC, VP9 and AV1 pictures are copied as they are; only the sound is new.

stepsTitle: How to add audio to a video

steps.title: Choose a video
steps.text: Pick the video that needs the new sound.

steps.title: Choose a sound
steps.text: Add an MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG or AAC file.

steps.title: Set the repeat
steps.text: Tick or untick “Repeat the sound if it’s shorter”.

steps.title: Add and download
steps.text: Click Add the sound, play the result and download it.

handles: Videos: MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV and others your browser can play.
Sounds: MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG and AAC.
Length: the result is as long as the video; the sound repeats or is cut to fit.
limits: The new sound replaces the video’s own sound; the two are not mixed.
The sound starts with the video; you can’t move it to start later.
One video and one sound file at a time.
faqTitle: Questions about adding audio to a video

faq.question: Is my video uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Adding the sound is done by your own browser, on your device, with the video encoders built into it. Nothing is sent to a server; open your browser's network panel while it runs and you will see no upload.

faq.question: What if the music is longer than the video?
faq.answer: It is cut where the video ends, so the result is exactly as long as the video.

faq.question: What if the music is shorter?
faq.answer: With “Repeat the sound if it’s shorter” ticked it starts again until the video ends; unticked, the rest of the video is silent.

faq.question: Is the video’s own sound kept?
faq.answer: No, the new sound replaces it. To remove the sound without adding another, use Mute video.

faq.question: Which sound files work?
faq.answer: MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG and AAC, as long as your browser can play them. If one doesn’t play, convert it to MP3 or WAV first.

faq.question: Is it free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
